result.summary: The layout is mostly coherent, but several rendering and consistency problems stand out: text and cards clipped at the right screen edge without ellipsis or padding, an implausible '-100%' promo badge, inconsistent favorite-icon and thumbnail styling, and duplicated delivery-fee information.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card ('Trattoria Piccol…') is hard-clipped by the viewport edge — the title is cut mid-word with no ellipsis and the card has no trailing gutter, so it reads as broken rather than as an intentional peek.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding/inset to the carousel so a partial card peeks cleanly, and truncate restaurant names with an ellipsis at the card width.

issues.description: The pizza card shows a '-100%' discount badge, which implies a fully free item and looks like a data/formatting error (likely meant to be a smaller percentage or a '100% off delivery' label).
issues.suggestion: Validate discount values and cap/format them correctly; clarify what the discount applies to (e.g. '-50%' or 'Free delivery').

issues.description: The two favorite (heart) buttons in 'Popular right now' use different treatments — the first is a white/light circle, the second a dark translucent circle — creating inconsistent visual language between identical controls.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent favorite-button style (same background, border and icon color) across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows '€0 delivery' twice: once as an image overlay badge and again in the metadata row below the title.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery information in only one place, preferably the badge, and omit it from the meta line.

issues.description: Thumbnail treatments are inconsistent: the 'Green Bowl Poké' image has a light grey background while the neighbouring cards use dark, vignetted photography, making the row look unbalanced.
issues.suggestion: Normalise image backgrounds/aspect and apply a consistent overlay or gradient to all card thumbnails.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off at the right edge with a sliver of the next chip visible and no fade or padding, which reads as clipped content rather than a scrollable list.
issues.suggestion: Add an edge fade/gradient or trailing padding to signal horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: Icon-only controls (notification bell with unread dot, heart/favorite buttons) have no visible text label, so their purpose and state rely solely on iconography.
issues.suggestion: Provide accessible names/labels (e.g. 'Save to favourites', 'Notifications, 1 unread') for screen readers and ensure states are announced.
